ocr.title: Automated text extraction
ocr.failedGeneric: Text extraction failed for this file.
ocr.allReviewed: All extracted fields have been reviewed.
ocr.notProcessed: This file hasn't been processed for text extraction yet.

formFields.title: Form fields
formFields.explainer: Handwritten values are never read automatically — check the source image and type what it says.
formFields.noSourceRegion: No source region was detected for this field — enter the value from the document.
formFields.correctionMarkHelp: Part of this value looks crossed out or corrected. Compare it with the crop and type the value the author intended. Nothing has been chosen automatically.
formFields.rawReading: Machine reading, including any crossed-out text:
formFields.suggestionWarning: A machine reading of the handwriting. It is often wrong, and its confidence is not a reliable guide. Check every character against the crop.
formFields.suggestionEmpty: The handwriting reader could not read this crop.

artistContact.title: Artist contact from this letter
artistContact.explainer: This document was classified as an artist authorization letter. Nothing here changes the artist record directly: you confirm the artist and the contact details, and a different reviewer approves the change in the archivist review queue.
artistContact.identityTitle: 1. Which artist is this letter from?
artistContact.noCandidates: No matching artist found. Try another spelling.

basis.exact_variant: Same as a recorded name variant

artistContact.confirmedLocked: Confirmed: {name}. This can't change while the contact proposal is open.
artistContact.contactExplainer: Check each value against the scanned document before sending. Values the scan didn't yield can be typed in.

source.needsTranscription: "{label}" hasn't been transcribed yet. Transcribe it above, or type the value here.
source.notDetected: Not detected on the scan. Type it in from the document.

artistContact.approvalNote: The artist record changes only after another reviewer approves this in the archivist review queue.
artistContact.cannotPropose: You don't have permission to submit proposals.
artistContact.awaitingReview: Waiting for approval in the archivist review queue.
artistContact.applied: Approved and applied to the artist's contacts.
artistContact.rejected: Rejected: {note}. You can correct the values and send again.

supersededReason.newer_proposal: Replaced by a later proposal from this document.
supersededReason.draft_rewritten: The draft carrying it was rewritten on the artist page.
supersededReason.other_proposal_approved: Another change to this artist was approved first.

values.currentNotKept: The value it replaced isn't kept once decided.
values.replacesExisting: Approving replaces the value the contact holds now.
